newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BASKETBALL-LITHUANIA WINS WOMEN'S EUROPEAN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-LITHUANIA WINS WOMEN'S EUROPEAN TITLE.

text.p: Lithuania beat Slovakia on Sunday and won the European women's Basketball Championship in an intense battle against Slovakia.
Both teams went for the same tactics in the first half, concentrating on the defense during the initial almost 10 minutes.
Slovakia was the first to start a powerful offensive which bore fruit as they took a six-point lead by the 16th minute.
The Lithuanians responded with even more determined counterattacks and in the remaining four minutes not only reduced their handicap but finished the first with a one-point advantage.

In the second half Lithuania increased its advantage to seven points (40:33) by the 23rd minute and almost instantly switched tactics adopting a somewhat slower gameplay, without losing any opportunity to score.
Slovakia, with its time running out, pushed harder and harder but could not find any holes in the massive Lithuanian defense.

The Slovak team began to fall apart during the last minutes and although they had some successful moves they could not shake the confidence of the Lithuanians who won a fully deserved European title 72-62.

The battle for the third place between Germany and Hungary was less balanced as the physically and tactically superior German team put just enough effort in the game to assure a comfortable victory over their opponents who were still under the effect of Saturday's beating they suffered from Slovakia.
The German team had a powerful start to five-nil and it took Hungary five minutes to score its first points.
Germany's Andrea Hohl orchestrated the game with skill and determination while on the other side there was little sign of cohesion.
By the middle of the second half Germany developed a 30-point lead but when it saw victory assured eased off thus the 86-61 final result did not exactly reflect the difference between the two teams.
